# Diagnosis — why do so few setups become entries? (2026-10-13)

**Descriptive only.** No strategy was changed, tested or promoted. Every number below is regenerated by `diagnose.py` from the verified
cloud backup `20261012T202501Z` (see `PROVENANCE.md`). Sample: Champion `decision_engine/gates-v1.1`, sessions 2026-09-25 .. 2026-10-12
(12 sessions), never pooled with v1.0. This sample is **small and in-sample**; the conclusions are leads, not proof.

## Bottom line
"Everything is rejected" is really **three different filters**, none of them a bug:

| Stage | Count | What removes the rest |
|---|---|---|
| Distinct setups seen (events) | 45 | — |
| Reached **TRADEABLE** (quality ≥ 60) | 20 | the quality score / `conviction` gate |
| Became **entries** | 4 (DELL, META, TMO, EOG) | **account capacity** |

At the decision level (245 v1.1 signals, repeats included): **78 REJECT (32%) · 111 MONITOR (45%) · 56 TRADEABLE (23%)**; 4 executed, all TRADEABLE.

## 1. 77% never reach TRADEABLE — the score is effectively one input
* `REJECT` = quality < 45 (hard floor) — 78 signals, all fail `quality_threshold` **and** `conviction`.
* `MONITOR` = quality 45–59.9 — 111 signals whose **only** failed gate is `conviction` (≥ 60). Every other gate (levels, +EV, liquidity,
  data quality, freshness, risk) passed.
* `quality = 100 × (½·agreement + ½·min(1, 2·|alignment|)) × (0.55 + 0.45·data_confidence) × execution_confidence`.
  In this sample every term except **alignment** is nearly constant — data coverage ≈ 64.5 %, family confidence ≈ 0.53–0.56,
  liquidity = 1.0 (medians by label in `diagnosis_results.json`). So quality ≈ a function of alignment alone.
* Alignment (confidence-weighted **mean** direction of the active evidence families) never exceeded **0.364**; quality never exceeded
  **68.7**; only 22.9 % of signals reach 60. A strong trend signal is averaged with weak/neutral families (e.g. a ≈ 0 market regime),
  which dilutes it below the bar. Median alignment: REJECT 0.158 · MONITOR 0.245 · TRADEABLE 0.318.

**Does the 60 bar pick better setups? Not visibly.** Following 40 setups forward from their first observation on the cloud's own
5-minute bars (no costs, stop-first, open positions marked at the last bar):

| First label | Setups | Target | Stop | Open | Mean R | Median R |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRADEABLE | 10 | 0 | 3 | 7 | +0.14 | +0.28 |
| MONITOR | 12 | 0 | 6 | 6 | −0.15 | −0.29 |
| REJECT | 18 | 1 | 7 | 10 | **+0.40** | +0.53 |

No monotone relationship. With n = 40, most positions still open and a rising market (all setups +0.17 R) this is **not** evidence that a
lower bar would be profitable — only that this sample gives no support for the bar as a selector.

## 2. TRADEABLE → entry is lost to account capacity (the larger loss)
Runtime funnel over 264 regular cycles: 1,319 finalist observations → 284 TRADEABLE → instrument verdict `NO_TRADE` on 1,313 finalists →
**6 judged stock-executable → 4 entries**. Of the 284 TRADEABLE observations (20 independent setups), only 6 had *no* account-fit violation:

| Violation (one observation can have several) | Observations |
|---|---|
| `max_positions_per_sector` (1 per sector) | 231 (81 %) |
| `max_sector_exposure` (30 %) | 151 (53 %) |
| `max_open_positions` (3) | 119 (42 %) |

At the **first** look, the 20 TRADEABLE setups were: **4 entered · 10 blocked by `max_open_positions` · 9 by a sector rule** (some by both) ·
1 by the daily order cap.

**What is holding the slots:** DELL (technology) and META (communication) were opened 2026-09-25 and have been open for **12 consecutive
sessions** — neither reached its stop or target — so 2 of 3 slots (and two sectors) were locked for the whole sample. Technology and
communication are where 9 of the 20 TRADEABLE setups appeared (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMD, CSCO, GOOGL, META …). The paper broker's only exit
reasons are stop and target; there is **no time-based exit** in `lab/paper` (the only age logic expires *signal tracking* after 20 days).

## 3. What this does and does not say
* No correctness defect found: gates, sizing and capacity behave as designed for a $500 cash account. (Two redundant sector limits —
  1 per sector and 30 % exposure vs a $125 position — are not a bug.)
* Consistent with `docs/PROFIT_MODE_BASELINE_v1.md`: **capacity, not conviction, binds** — and now a specific mechanism is visible:
  dead capital in two slots.
* Cannot say: that a time stop helps (it could exit before a recovery), that the 60 bar is wrong, or that any threshold is "best".

## Hypotheses this motivates (each a separate, pre-registered Challenger — Champion stays frozen)
1. **CH-003 — dead-capital / time stop** (registered next; `../ch003_time_stop/PREREG.md`).
2. **Conviction / score structure** — test the bar and the averaging separately, never mixed into CH-003.
3. Slot ranking was CH-002 (uninformative on little data).

Selection effect, stated up front: CH-003 was suggested by *this* sample, so in-sample results are exploratory; only sessions after
2026-10-12 can count as out-of-sample evidence.
